key_highlights: ASX (^AXJO) advanced following positive Wall Street leads and falling crude oil prices easing inflationary pressures.
ANZ Group (ANZ.AX) reported a full-year profit surge to $7.6B despite rising mortgage delinquencies and household debt distress.
Energy sector faced headwinds as crude oil slumped on geopolitical de-escalation hopes, while Beetaloo Basin approvals provided selective upside.
Materials sector showed resilience with iron ore stabilizing and junior exploration discoveries in gold and critical minerals.
Qantas (QAN.AX) announced 850 domestic job cuts via offshoring to India to protect margins amid competitive pressures.

sectors.trend: Earnings resilience countered by rising credit impairment risks.
sectors.implications: Major banks (ANZ.AX, CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX) maintain strong net interest margins, but rising 90+ day mortgage arrears and restrictive RBA policy elevate credit risk provisions.

sectors.trend: Crude oil weakness dampening upstream margins despite domestic gas milestones.
sectors.implications: Sharply lower global oil prices pressure heavyweights Woodside Energy (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX), though domestic gas players benefit from Beetaloo licence approvals.

sectors.trend: Iron ore consolidation alongside momentum in gold and critical minerals.
sectors.implications: Diversified majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) remain anchored by Chinese steel demand sentiment, while high-grade gold hits and rare earths exploration offer tactical upside.

sectors.trend: Spillover volatility from US semiconductor geopolitical probes.
sectors.implications: Shareholder and federal scrutiny on Nvidia weighed on global tech sentiment, though broader market resilience and data centre infrastructure demand support local tech (WTC.AX, NXT.AX).

sectors.trend: Aggressive cost rationalisation and construction sector insolvencies.
sectors.implications: Qantas (QAN.AX) structural cost-cutting via offshoring underscores margin defence; construction collapse highlights persistent margin pressure across building and contracting firms.

key_themes: Monetary policy transmission: RBA rate settings continue squeezing mortgage holders while supporting bank profitability.
Input cost relief: Plunging crude oil prices alleviate aviation and freight transport input costs.
Counter-cyclical corporate restructuring: Cost offshoring and builder collapses reflect elevated domestic operating costs.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight exposed regional lenders; focus on major banks with robust CET1 capital ratios and provisioning buffers.
Avoid sub-tier contractors and REITs with high direct development exposures; prioritize prime A-grade asset holders.
Maintain balanced exposure across US-dollar revenue earners (BHP.AX, CSL.AX) to hedge currency swings and oil margin contractions.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on airline margin expansion driven by lower jet fuel costs and operational restructuring
opportunities.rationale: Crude oil sell-off and 850 back-office job cuts reduce cash burn and bolster operating margins.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate premier banking franchises post-earnings on dividend yield support
opportunities.rationale: Surging statutory profit ($7.6B) and resilient balance sheet offset near-term delinquency headwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to domestic natural gas and high-grade precious metals
opportunities.rationale: Licensing milestones in Beetaloo and strong gold resource additions provide non-correlated alpha.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge exposure against consumer discretionary and interest rate-sensitive debt
defensive_moves.rationale: Sustained household financial stress and mortgage arrears threaten retail spending and housing turnover.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce pure-play upstream energy exposure vulnerable to oil price breakdown
defensive_moves.rationale: Global crude price deflation limits near-term free cash flow yields and dividend upside.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading between 8,150 and 8,350 as easing energy costs offset domestic consumer headwinds and banking arrears.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously positive medium-term outlook supported by structural resource demand, eventual RBA easing cycle, and bank capital strength.
key_catalysts: RBA Board cash rate decisions and monetary policy statement releases
Global crude oil supply stabilization and OPEC+ policy responses
China economic stimulus announcements impacting bulk commodity demand (iron ore/coal)
Australian domestic inflation (CPI) and labor market prints
watch_list: Major bank 90+ day residential mortgage delinquency rates
Singapore iron ore futures (62% Fe CFR)
Brent and WTI crude oil benchmarks
